purpose: Three independent states per the operating workflow — eliminates permanent-pending. Grading, benchmarking, and execution advance independently.

P4_forward_challenger.benchmark_status: PER-SLATE (single-book de-vig where a same-book close exists; else UNATTRIBUTED)
P4_forward_challenger.execution_status: UNAUTHORIZED (betting authorization closed — does NOT block forecasting or learning)
P4_forward_challenger.disposition: INCONCLUSIVE (forced; not PENDING) — accumulating diagnostic evidence toward a pre-registered gate

standing_rule.missing_prices: do NOT prevent outcome grading (grade proceeds on the official result)
standing_rule.missing_lineups: do NOT block ML (V13 does not consume lineups); only lineup-consuming models block
standing_rule.unattributed_odds: block market comparison ONLY, not model learning
standing_rule.execution: UNAUTHORIZED is a stable state, not a blocker on forecasting/evaluation

note: Per-game T-120/T-30 versioned states (FORECAST_T120_v1, FINAL_PREGAME|DIAGNOSTIC, benchmark sidecar, first-pitch lock, LATE_CAPTURE) are emitted by the pregame Routine going forward; this file is the program-level rollup.
